label: ext.blocktype ext.relationtype
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.relationtype

properties.name: the domain relation type the Block describes; unique among established definitions, so the definition set is an unambiguous namespace

createParameters.semantics: Describes a relation type an extension defines. Validation enforces established definitions: relations claiming the type resolve against them, a definition never shadows a code-registered type, and a breaking definition change requires an ext.migration Block in its proposal group. Relations store no properties, so relation-adjacent data lives in endpoint Block content.
